column1: # Initial manifest installation order (P/02.4 N1.7 install steps; stage C guess I02-INSTALL-ORDER). Form: README.

column4: testsub2 requests testsub (requests edge) and is near it (near gives no order, ADR-0091 addendum (26)); testsub creates and uses give no order: their checks wait for the target
No edges: order names by bytes
c requests b: b precedes c; near b to a gives no order (ADR-0091 addendum (26)): a and b sort by name
d requests b and c; near b and c to a gives no order (ADR-0091 addendum (26)); ready entries sort by name
Mutual creates and uses do not form a cycle: neither imposes an order
A requests cycle in an empty store refuses installation with code 2 before changes (ADR-0091 addendum (27) item 4: cycles follow requests)
p requests q and q is near p: no cycle, since near gives no order; requests determines the order (ADR-0091 addendum (26) item 1, addendum (27) item 4)
q is already installed: p to installed q gives no order, leaving q requests p, without a cycle
A target outside this installation gives no order; its existence is checked by the P/02.1 N3 catalogue check
Near alone gives no order: a is near b but installs first by name (ADR-0091 addendum (26) item 1, addendum (27) item 4)
